product_metadata.title: Electric Indoor Grill Portable Smokeless Kitchen Non Stick Cooking BBQ Griddle
features: Cooking area: 15*10 inch. Extra large cooking surface, allows multiple ingredients to be cooked at the same time, useful for a variety of meals.

Featuring a separate heater and grill plate, the ribbed design of the cooking surface ensures complete heat coverage of the grill plate and lets you achieve the best results. Special channel design at bottom side of die-cast aluminum grill plate. Protects the heater better and extend service time.

Ideal for dinner parties, individual meals, barbecue-style food, stir frys. Portable grill is great for travelling, especially for camping and caravanning holidays. It is easy to carry and move anywhere you need it.

Non-stick surface means very little oil needs to be used. The ribbed surface with holes and oil drip tray keep the food free of fat and grease, meaning food cooked on the grill is healthier and retains its natural flavour. And the large cooking surface which is easy to clean with its non-stick coated surface.
Features an adjustable temperature control, which can be adjusted to your desired temperature for different food.
description: Grill indoors all year long with the Excelvan Indoor Grill. Featuring an extra-large cooking surface is large enough to grill a meal for your whole family or group. Featuring a separate heater and grill plate, this grill and griddle distributes heat evenly for consistently grilled food without overly hot or cold spots. The ribbed design of the cooking surface ensures complete heat coverage of the grill plate and lets you achieve the best results. Grill to perfection with the aid of an adjustable thermostat, and enjoy easy cleanup with a removable, nonstick drip tray. The non-stick surface means very little oil needs to be used. In addition, the ribbed surface with holes and oil drip tray keep the food free of fat and grease, meaning food cooked on the grill is healthier and retains its natural flavour. Ideal for hosting dinner parties, preparing individual meals, barbecue-style food and stir frys, grill variety of meats, poultry, sausage, seafood, and vegetables. Bring the Excelvan grill to your home, means bring cuisine to your home! Non-stick surface means very little oil needs to be used. The ribbed grill surface with holes and oil drip tray keep the food free of fat and grease, meaning food cooked on the grill is healthier and retains its natural flavour. The nonstick drip tray collects drippings while you grill. For easy cleanup, simply remove the tray and empty its contents. Large capacity grease drip tray, need to fill with water to cool down and reduce smoke. The grill's nonstick cooking surface ensures fast and easy cleanup. After grilling is complete, simply wipe the cooking surface clean.
